# PART 4 – Replication and preregistration {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Last part. So far everything has happened on one file, the thousand emails of the original study. Now we leave it behind. First a look at how far the answer moves when the analysis changes on those same data, and then the new audit that SCORE ran to test the claim again, with new emails, new names and a plan registered before the first email went out. We read that plan and the report beside it, look at where the public record of the case is kept, and then you fill in a preregistration of your own, which fixes an analysis before any result exists.
:::
